description: Department of Agrarian Development - Notify the rent to the paid by the tenant cultivator to the landlord under Agrarian Development Act
reasoning: This gazette notification contains a legal determination made under the Agrarian Development Act, No. 46 of 2000 as amended. It establishes regulatory requirements for rent payments for paddy cultivation and other agricultural crops, specifying detailed rates and conditions. While it mentions a government official (Commissioner General of Agrarian Development), this is in the context of exercising statutory powers to make a legal/regulatory determination rather than a personnel appointment or government restructuring. The content primarily focuses on establishing legal requirements and regulations for agricultural land use.
